# SPDX license id

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:spdxLicenseId`](gmeow-spdxLicenseId.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/spdxLicenseId>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The SPDX [`License`](../classes/gmeow-License.md) List short identifier of a licence — the canonical machine-readable licence id (e.g. "MIT", "Apache-2.0", "CC-BY-4.0", "GPL-3.0-only"). The bridge to the SPDX / SBOM world ([spdx:licenseId](http://spdx.org/rdf/terms#licenseId)); the SPDX List also assigns each id a stable IRI under http://spdx.org/licenses/. Functional: a licence has one canonical SPDX id (a compound choice is an SPDX licence expression in the same literal).

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:License`](../classes/gmeow-License.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:spdxLicenseId`](gmeow-spdxLicenseId.md) from [`gmeow:License`](../classes/gmeow-License.md) to [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to carry the canonical SPDX short identifier of a licence — the machine-readable id that bridges to SPDX / SBOM tooling and resolves to a stable SPDX IRI by reference (P5).

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for the coarse family (that is [`gmeow:licenseFamily`](gmeow-licenseFamily.md)) or the human-readable name ([`gmeow:spdxLicenseName`](gmeow-spdxLicenseName.md)), and avoid splitting a compound choice across triples — a dual choice is one SPDX licence expression in the same literal.

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:spdxLicenseId`](gmeow-spdxLicenseId.md) once per [`License`](../classes/gmeow-License.md) (functional) to a valid SPDX id or expression; consumers resolve the stable http://spdx.org/licenses/ IRI from it rather than importing the licence text.

### Examples

- ex:apacheLicense [`gmeow:spdxLicenseId`](gmeow-spdxLicenseId.md) "Apache-2.0".
